# Rahul Singh Shekhawat

> Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer based in Mumbai, India. I design, build, and operate production systems on AWS — serverless architecture, Node.js backends, and AI-powered SaaS — and write detailed engineering write-ups about how those systems actually work.

## Summary

- Full-stack development with Node.js, Fastify, TypeScript, React, and Next.js
- AWS cloud architecture: Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EC2/ECS Fargate, S3, Route 53, DynamoDB, RDS
- AI systems engineering: LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, agent tracing, and AI observability
- Cloud cost optimization and FinOps tooling (up to 35% AWS spend reduction on real projects)
- Open-source developer tooling, including env-secret-lock (AES-256-GCM secret management CLI)
- Technical writing on serverless patterns, observability, and system design

## Technical focus areas

- [Cloud engineering](https://rahulshekhawat.dev/specialization/cloud-engineer): AWS infrastructure, IaC, reliability, and FinOps cost control
- [AWS & serverless](https://rahulshekhawat.dev/specialization/aws-developer): API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, and event-driven backends
- [Full-stack engineering](https://rahulshekhawat.dev/specialization/full-stack-developer): Node.js APIs, React/Next.js interfaces, cloud deployment
- [Node.js engineering](https://rahulshekhawat.dev/specialization/node-js-developer): Fastify, distributed workers, and developer tooling
- [AI engineering](https://rahulshekhawat.dev/specialization/ai-engineer): LLM pipelines, agent observability, and telemetry
- [Serverless architecture](https://rahulshekhawat.dev/specialization/serverless-engineer): event-driven design, concurrency, and cost control
